featured_reviews.name: Anusha Sundaram
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've heard so much about the wonders of The Boston Cupcakery. However, our enthusiasm to try out this place wasn't translated into a wonderful experience.

This small outlet is located within a dense commercial/residential area. You'd need a cab to get here because parking was a little difficult.

There isn't a lot of seating. Only one table is there in the AC area and another in the outside seating area. There isn't any music available and the lighting was really off. The lights kept flickering. We had to request that they be switched off.

We first went in for the 24-layer Pastry. This is a very good dessert. Even though there are so many layers of cream and cake, the dessert wasn't very heavy. It's great for sharing.

The next came the Red Velvet Pastry. There's no other way to describe it than just plain terrible. This is the worst version of this cake I have had so far. The cake looked a little slumped when it was served to us but we didn't think much about it. With one small slice, the entire pastry collapsed. The cake itself wasn't so good and the icing was very off. There were instances where we thought this might be a cheesecake but it wasn't. The cake had a room temperature which might indicate that the refrigeration of the desserts aren't up to the mark.

I'm not pleased with the variation in the quality of desserts. One was good while the other was terrible making it difficult for me to recommend this place.

The pizza is too small. Smaller than you'd expect for sure. It mostly had the tomato taste in the chicken pizza and I don't remember one piece of chicken getting in my mouth from the pizza. It also kinda felt like rubber and didn't taste very good.
The burger had mayonnaise that didn't taste very good. The patty was okay and didn't taste great either. The bun was stale. It was hard and did not taste good.

The first time i ordered from this place, it was a good experience but the second time wasn't. The food delivered to my was cold for which I don't blame the store but the packaging was not good. I ordered 7 items which were all stuffed inside a single packet and the pattice was not even packed. It was just lying in the bag. No ketchup either. The price is good though which is the reason the experience wasn't so bad.

Cakes are always amazing, it looks so good and more good than my expectation. I have been order her cakes several times but never tasted it, bcs i'm not there. But my bf always said it tasted really good and amazing. I'll soon taste your cakes anna 😇

featured_reviews.name: shreyansa shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: We had ordered cake on two seperate occasions from Anna's bakery. The cakes were custom made as per our request with Anna spending good time to talk us through what options we could utilise and everything extra that can be done for making the cakes personalised. Both turned out to be really awesome and special without compromising on the taste aspect of the cakes.

featured_reviews.name: Simpson Gomes
featured_reviews.review_text: The cake was really awesome 👌 all of them appreciated the beautiful pattern of the cake and it was really delicious and tasty. Thank you for all the efforts and arrangements you made for delivering the cake on time. Keep up the good work 👍

featured_reviews.name: Flavia Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: The cake was Super Delicious and had ordered Easter Sweets as well in past rightly and amazingly made and was yummy everyone enjoyed it alots...looking forward for some more sweets and cup- cakes specially in future..❤️😋

featured_reviews.name: carol noronha
featured_reviews.review_text: I've been ordering Easter eggs and Christmas sweets(Marzipan) from Anna since 2021.. I love the taste and design, and surprisingly every year there is no compromise on the taste. She always keeps me coming back for more every year. Best ever!!!!

featured_reviews.name: Onil D'souza
featured_reviews.review_text: We couldn’t have asked for a better cake to celebrate our little one’s christening. It was a beautiful centerpiece that added a touch of sweetness to our joyous occasion. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Smily Fonseca
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had ordered easter eggs from Anna's delight. She had so many varieties to choose from. I had ordered the chocolate and marzipan one's. I'd like to mention that not only did they taste good but the presentation was so very well done. Especially the hollow easter eggs that had little goodies in it. All the kids that I gave it to were so happy with it.
Would highly recommend to anyone looking for great quality and presentation of cakes and other goodies!

featured_reviews.review_text: Occasions Chakala is a nice venue — clean, well-decorated and suitable for small to medium gatherings. The staff was cooperative and handled arrangements smoothly. Catering was decent and the overall ambience felt pleasant. Parking can be a bit tight during busy events, but overall it’s a good place for functions.

featured_reviews.review_text: In February 2022 I have called Occasions at J B Nagar n asked if they can make personalised cake for my sister n they assured me that they will do it. I gave them all pictures in morning n cake was ready by evening n cake was amazing. After that we have ordered two more cakes n each time cakes were amazing. Yesterday was my birthday n my sister ordered the cake n since I m artist ,she gave me picture of one of my paintings n my God,what a beautiful cake they have made n taste wise also yummy.

featured_reviews.review_text:
It was my son's 5 th birthday and also my Nanajee's 60 th birthday simultaneously. So I wanted the cake to be really special. The team really listens to your requirements patiently, they spent almost 1&1/2 hours discussing the cake I had in mind. Gave suggestions which would suit exactly my requests. All my guests enjoyed the cake very much.
My son normally is allergic to cream and sugar combination and ends up having allergic bronchitis after having cakes. But cakes here are so fresh that seriously nothing happens to him after having cakes from here.
I love the cakes they bake, they beautiful to look at, super tasty and have vast range of flavours to choose from. Already have recommended the name to a lot of my friends and family.
You are doing a good job!! Keep up with that.
Kudos to the team!!!

In fact one of the staff came out of the shop and helped me get an autorickshaw since I had purchased a lot of stuff and couldn’t handle it.

featured_reviews.name: Disha Chokhani
featured_reviews.review_text: This is our favorite cake shop. For each and every “OCCASSION” a cake is must from this place. Their cakes are fresh and tasty. Service is good. They get the timely delivery done as per our request. Have many varieties and flavors of cakes. One of my most preferred cake store when it comes to buying cakes from this area.

featured_reviews.name: Peuly Maiti
featured_reviews.review_text: Occasions is my go to joint for all my cake needed events. The best designs, variety, hospitality, customisation, perfection, skill, commitment & professionalism that I can get. One of my recent order for a 6kg Dutch truffle cake with my customized bengali wedding design perfectly hand crafted & delivered. Quality was top-notch. Even refrigerated for 2-3 days & consumed. Thanks for the amazing experience!

featured_reviews.name: Swarika Biwalkar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had ordered a Piano themed cake for my brothers 50th birthday. Even it's been a same day order for customized cake, Occasions really did a great job. The cake was amazing. Look was almost 90% similar to what I had sent them, but the cream and the flavor was just so perfect. Pineapple flavor was  really cream with full of fresh pineapple pieces. Thank you Occasions foe making our evening.

featured_reviews.name: Raghu Rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was my dad's 70th birthday. So wanted a cake with some message to be written on it.
Me and wife had something in our mind, the manager and chef spent enough time to help manifest in awesome cake. Liked and appreciated by everyone especially Dad and Mom.

Thank you so much.
